products.introEn: The Baby Fat cross makes a small amount of silver feel remarkably sculptural. Its flared arms and rounded center create a clear silhouette, while darker recesses bring the raised surfaces into focus. At the size listed here, the pendant reads as a compact detail at the neckline, with enough depth to reward a closer look. The appeal lies in that change of scale: a quiet silver shape from across the room, then a more intricate object in the hand. This selected resale piece offers a direct introduction to the motif.
featuresEn: A flared cross motif in .925 sterling silver.
Seller-listed pendant length of 0.75 inch; no gemstones are listed.
Pendant-only listing; a chain is not described or pictured.
products.stylingEn: Choose a separate fine silver chain that suits the pendant loop, then let the cross sit above a simple crewneck or inside an open collar. A single plain ring can echo the metal without crowding the small silhouette. Check chain compatibility before pairing.

products.introEn: The Dagger pendant builds its character around a long central line. An open, scrolling hilt gives the top a sense of movement, while the blade draws the eye downward and keeps the composition narrow. Raised lettering and darkened recesses make the silver surface feel layered even before the pendant turns. This two-inch example has enough length to become a clear focal point over a plain shirt. Its shape is useful for anyone drawn to jewelry with a strong outline, where the interest comes from carved detail and proportion rather than gemstones.
featuresEn: A dagger silhouette with open scrollwork in .925 sterling silver.
Seller-listed pendant length of 2 inches; no gemstones are listed.
Pendant-only listing; a chain is not described or pictured.
products.stylingEn: Pair it with a separate chain that can pass through the pendant loop and leave clear space around the blade. A dark cotton shirt makes the open hilt and silver edges easy to see. Keep nearby pendants short enough to avoid overlapping its outline.

products.introEn: A dog tag gives the Vine Dagger motif a broad silver surface to work against. The rounded rectangular outline is familiar, but its cutout center changes the effect: light, fabric and skin become part of the composition. The dagger and curling shapes remain readable as the tag shifts, with the ball chain adding a fine, repeated rhythm above it. This selected listing includes the thirty-inch chain, creating a longer line than a close necklace. It is a useful choice for styling over clothing, where the open center can register against a simple background.
featuresEn: Cutout Vine Dagger motif on a .925 sterling-silver dog tag.
Seller-listed pendant length of 2.25 inches; no gemstones are listed.
products.stylingEn: Let the long ball chain fall over a plain knit, heavyweight tee or open overshirt. A solid background makes the cutout center easy to read. Keep any second necklace visibly shorter, and check where the tag lands when seated as well as standing.
